name: kaizen-desktop
description: The kaizen board in its own window.
author: Husein Fadhlullah

scripts.compile: bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external electron --external electron-updater
scripts.stage: bun run scripts/stage.ts && bun run scripts/fetch-bun.ts
scripts.dist: bun run stage && bun run compile && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
